rows.label: Anthony Bourdain
rows.hook: wrote a blunt kitchen memoir, then hosted globe-trotting shows about food and culture

rows.label: Gordon Ramsay
rows.description: British chef, restaurateur, and television personality (born 1966)
rows.hook: is a fiery, foul-mouthed TV chef with a huge Michelin-starred restaurant group

rows.label: Prue Leith
rows.description: South African-British chef, writer, television personality, businesswoman
rows.hook: judges bakers in a famous tented competition after replacing Mary Berry

rows.label: Bobby Flay
rows.description: American celebrity chef, restaurateur and reality television personality
rows.hook: is a grill-loving Food Network star known for challenging rivals to cook-offs

rows.label: Marco Pierre White
rows.hook: became the youngest chef to earn three Michelin stars and once trained Gordon Ramsay

rows.label: Ina Garten
rows.hook: hosts a Food Network show about easy, elegant home entertaining and her roast chicken

rows.label: Jamie Oliver
rows.hook: rose to fame as a casual young TV cook and campaigned for healthier school dinners

rows.label: Delia Smith
rows.hook: taught generations of home cooks the basics and co-owns a Norwich football club

rows.label: Alton Brown
rows.hook: hosts a science-minded Food Network show and commentates on Iron Chef America

rows.label: Rachael Ray
rows.description: American television host, businesswoman, celebrity cook, and author
rows.hook: built a cooking empire on quick 30-minute meals and a daytime talk show

rows.label: Paula Deen
rows.description: American cook, cooking show host, restaurateur, author, actress, and television personality
rows.hook: is a Savannah cook famed for buttery Southern comfort food and her restaurant The Lady and Sons

rows.label: Heston Blumenthal
rows.hook: is a pioneer of scientific cooking, famed for snail porridge and bacon-and-egg ice cream

rows.label: Rick Stein
rows.description: English chef, writer and television presenter
rows.hook: is a TV seafood champion with a restaurant empire in the Cornish fishing town of Padstow

rows.label: Thomas Keller
rows.description: American chef, restaurateur, and cookbook writer

rows.label: Gino D'Acampo
rows.description: Italian celebrity chef and television personality
rows.hook: won a jungle reality show and became a TV regular cooking Italian food in Britain

rows.label: Wolfgang Puck
rows.hook: launched a celebrated Sunset Strip restaurant that grew into a worldwide dining empire

rows.label: Pati Jinich
rows.description: Mexican chef, TV personality, cookbook author
